## AMR Drug Class Plots
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(compositions)
library(vegan)

#setwd() 
amr_file_dir <- "../../data/Metagenomics/CARD_amr/allele_mapping"

### Read in all AMR annotation files
amr_files <- list.files(
  path = amr_file_dir,
  pattern = "\\.allele_mapping_data\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
print(amr_files)


#-----------------------------
# 2) Function to read in amr anno file
#-----------------------------
read_one_amr <- function(f) {
  dt <- fread(f, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = FALSE)

  # Extract sample names
  base <- basename(f)
  sample <- str_replace(base, "\\.allele_mapping_data\\.txt$", "")
  sample <- str_replace(sample, "_all$", "")
  print(sample)

  # Check column names
  required <- c("ARO Accession", "ARO Term", "Completely Mapped Reads")
  missing <- setdiff(required, colnames(dt))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(paste0("File missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
                " | file = ", f))
  }

  dt %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = sample,
      ARO_Accession = `ARO Accession`,
      ARO_Term = `ARO Term`,
      Completely_Mapped_Reads = as.numeric(`Completely Mapped Reads`),
      Drug_Class = `Drug Class`
    )
}


# Combining all files into one large table
amr_all <- bind_rows(lapply(amr_files, read_one_amr)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Completely_Mapped_Reads))



###### Analysis based on "Drug Class"
# ### Using Original Combined Drug Class
# # Calculate the relative reads contribution of specific "Drug Class" in each sample
# amr_term_by_sample <- amr_all %>%
#   group_by(Sample, Drug_Class) %>%
#   summarise(reads = sum(Completely_Mapped_Reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
#   group_by(Sample) %>%
#   mutate(
#     total_reads = sum(reads, na.rm = TRUE),
#     rel_reads = if_else(total_reads > 0, reads / total_reads, 0)
#   ) %>%
#   ungroup()

### Using Seperated Drug Class
amr_all_expanded <- amr_all %>%
  mutate(.row_id = row_number(),
         Drug_Class = na_if(Drug_Class, ""),
         Drug_Class = str_replace_all(Drug_Class, "\\s*;\\s*", "; ")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Drug_Class)) %>%
  separate_rows(Drug_Class, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
  mutate(Drug_Class = str_trim(Drug_Class)) %>%
  group_by(.row_id) %>%
  mutate(n_class = n(),
         Completely_Mapped_Reads_adj = Completely_Mapped_Reads / n_class) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate the relative reads contribution of specific "Drug Class" in each sample
amr_term_by_sample <- amr_all_expanded %>%
  group_by(Sample, Drug_Class) %>%
  summarise(reads = sum(Completely_Mapped_Reads_adj, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    total_reads = sum(reads, na.rm = TRUE),
    rel_reads = if_else(total_reads > 0, reads / total_reads, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Convert to AMR wide table for clustering
amr_mat <- amr_term_by_sample %>%
  select(Sample, Drug_Class, rel_reads) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Drug_Class,
    values_from = rel_reads,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(amr_mat) <- amr_mat$Sample
amr_mat$Sample <- NULL


# # Calculate and analysis with Aitchison distance
# pseudo <- 1e-6
# amr_mat_clr <- clr(amr_mat + pseudo)
# 
# dist_aitch <- dist(amr_mat_clr, method = "euclidean")
# hc_aitch <- hclust(dist_aitch, method = "average")
# 
# plot(hc_aitch, main = "Hierarchical clustering of samples (Aitchison distance)")
# cluster_order <- hc_aitch$labels[hc_aitch$order]
# cluster_order


# Calculate and analysis with Bray-Curtis distance
dist_bray <- vegdist(amr_mat, method = "bray")
hc_bray <- hclust(dist_bray, method = "average")

plot(hc_bray, main = "Hierarchical clustering of samples (Bray-Curtis distance)")
cluster_order <- hc_bray$labels[hc_bray$order]
cluster_order





# Select top 16 Drug Classes with highest relative reads contribution across all samples
#top_n <- 16
top_n <- 15
top_terms <- amr_term_by_sample %>%
  group_by(Drug_Class) %>%
  summarise(score = sum(rel_reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  pull(Drug_Class)

# Barplot for all samples of Drug Class contriutions (relative), Colored with "Drug Class"
#-----------------------------
# Combine other clasees into "Other"
#-----------------------------
plot_df <- amr_term_by_sample %>%
  mutate(Drug_Class_plot = if_else(Drug_Class %in% top_terms, Drug_Class, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Drug_Class_plot) %>%
  summarise(rel_reads = sum(rel_reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Set the order of factors: Top classes + Other
levels_all <- c(top_terms, "Other")
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Drug_Class_plot = factor(Drug_Class_plot, levels = levels_all))

#-----------------------------
# Set colors
#-----------------------------
cols <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(length(top_terms))
term_colors <- setNames(c(cols, "grey70"), levels_all)

label_map <- setNames(
  ifelse(nchar(levels_all) > 40, paste0(substr(levels_all, 1, 40), "..."), levels_all),
  levels_all
)

#-----------------------------
# 8) Stacked barchart
#-----------------------------
# Set sample order as cluster results
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Sample = factor(Sample, levels = cluster_order))

p_bar <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Sample, y = rel_reads, fill = Drug_Class_plot)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Top ", top_n, " Drug classes by relative mapped reads"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "AMR Drug Class Relative Abundance",
    fill = "AMR Drug Class"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = term_colors,
    breaks = levels_all,
    labels = unname(label_map[levels_all]),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

p_bar
```

### AMR relative abundance plot
```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

### Read in CARD-kmer results
card_result_file <- file.path("../../data/Metagenomics/CARD_amr", "mapping_summary.tsv")
card_result <- read.table(card_result_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
head(card_result)
# Extract Individual Name from Sample Name
card_result <- card_result %>%
  mutate(
    individual = str_extract(sample, "^[^_]+")
  )

card_result$mapped_reads_percentage <- card_result$Mapped_reads/card_result$Total_reads
head(card_result)


card_result <- card_result %>%
  rename(Sample = sample) %>%
  mutate(Sample = str_remove(Sample, "_all\\.txt$"))

head(card_result)


# Set sample order
sample_order <- unique(plot_df$Sample)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order))

card_result <- card_result %>%
  mutate(Sample = factor(Sample, levels = sample_order))



### Final Modification on the AMR data
# Convert drug class name into upper letter
capitalize_first <- function(x) {
  str_replace(as.character(x), "^([a-z])", ~ str_to_upper(.x))
}

levels_all <- capitalize_first(c(top_terms, "Other"))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    Drug_Class_plot = capitalize_first(Drug_Class_plot),
    Drug_Class_plot = factor(Drug_Class_plot, levels = levels_all)
  )



### New set of colors to keep consistent with taxa figures
# Unified palette
taxa_no_other <- setdiff(levels_all, "Other")

base_cols <- c(
  brewer.pal(8, "Set2"),
  brewer.pal(12, "Set3"),
  brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  brewer.pal(9, "Set1")
)

bad_cols <- c(
  "#D9D9D9",
  "#B3B3B3",
  "#FFFFB3",
  "#B3DE69",
  "#FFED6F"
)

base_cols <- base_cols[!toupper(base_cols) %in% toupper(bad_cols)]

if (length(taxa_no_other) > length(base_cols)) {
  stop("Not enough colors in base_cols for all drug classes.")
}

term_colors <- base_cols[seq_along(taxa_no_other)]

term_colors <- c(term_colors, Other = "grey70")
term_colors <- term_colors[levels_all]

filtered_card_result <- card_result %>% filter(!Sample  %in% c("NW046_5", "NW016_2_2", "NW016_5"))

sample_order_chr <- as.character(cluster_order)
filtered_sample_order <- sample_order_chr[!sample_order_chr %in% samples_to_remove]

filtered_card_result <- filtered_card_result %>%

# Main Plot：Drug class composition
```

### Study association between AMR drug class relative abundance and total AMR relative abundance
```{r}
### Read in AMR relative abundance from the previous section
head(filtered_card_result)
nrow(filtered_card_result)


### Read in Drug Class relative abundance
table_file <- file.path("../../data/Metagenomics/CARD_amr/", "AMR_drug_class_bar_plot_table.csv")
drug_class_table <- read.csv(table_file)
head(drug_class_table)




# Check whether sample IDs match
setdiff(unique(drug_class_table$Sample), unique(filtered_card_result$Sample))
setdiff(unique(filtered_card_result$Sample), unique(drug_class_table$Sample))

# Merge total AMR relative abundance into the drug-class table
combined_table <- drug_class_table %>%
  left_join(filtered_card_result, by = "Sample")

head(combined_table)
nrow(combined_table)



### Studying association between Drug Class relative abundance and AMR relative abundance, calculate spearman correlation coefficient

drug_class_cor_result <- combined_table %>%
  group_by(Drug_Class_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = sum(!is.na(rel_reads) & !is.na(mapped_reads_percentage)),
    spearman_rho = suppressWarnings(
      cor(rel_reads, mapped_reads_percentage,
          method = "spearman",
          use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    p_value = suppressWarnings(
      cor.test(rel_reads, mapped_reads_percentage,
               method = "spearman",
               exact = FALSE)$p.value
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_BH, p_value)

drug_class_cor_result
head(drug_class_cor_result)


### Optional: save results
write.csv(
  drug_class_cor_result,
  file.path("../../data/Metagenomics/CARD_amr/", "AMR_drug_class_vs_total_AMR_spearman.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)



### Optional: visualize correlation coefficients
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)


plot_df <- drug_class_cor_result %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label = case_when(
      p_adj_BH < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj_BH < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj_BH < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    Drug_Class_plot = fct_reorder(Drug_Class_plot, spearman_rho)
  )

p_drug_class_cor <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Drug_Class_plot, y = spearman_rho)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sig_label),
    hjust = ifelse(plot_df$spearman_rho >= 0, -0.2, 1.2),
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      min(-0.6, min(plot_df$spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.08),
      max( 0.6, max(plot_df$spearman_rho, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08)
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    # title = "Association between the relative abundance of \nspecific AMR drug classes and total AMR relative abundance",
    x = "Drug class",
    y = "Spearman's rho"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
  )

p_drug_class_cor


ggsave(
  filename = file.path("../../results/MG_results/AMR_results/", "AMR_drug_class_vs_total_AMR_spearman.jpg"),
  plot = p_drug_class_cor,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600)

### Scatter plot between drug class relative abundance and AMR abundance
head(combined_table)

### 1. Prepare plotting data
plot_df <- combined_table %>%
  mutate(
    mapped_pct = `mapped_reads_percentage`
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mapped_pct), !is.na(rel_reads), !is.na(Drug_Class_plot))

### 2. Make sure statistics table has the same Drug_Class_plot names
stat_df <- drug_class_cor_result %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      #"n = ", n_samples,
      "\nSpearman rho = ", round(spearman_rho, 3),
      "\np = ", signif(p_value, 3),
      "\nBH-adjusted p = ", signif(p_adj_BH, 3)
    )
  )

### 3. Get all drug classes
drug_classes <- unique(plot_df$Drug_Class_plot)

### 4. Create one plot for each drug class
plot_list <- lapply(drug_classes, function(dc) {
  
  df_sub <- plot_df %>%
    filter(Drug_Class_plot == dc)
  
  stat_sub <- stat_df %>%
    filter(Drug_Class_plot == dc)
  
  # If there is no matching stat row, create empty label
  ann_label <- if (nrow(stat_sub) > 0) stat_sub$label[1] else ""
  
  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = mapped_pct, y = rel_reads)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8, linetype = 2) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = ann_label,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.1,
      size = 5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = dc,
      x = "AMR Relative Abundance (%)",
      y = "AMR Drug Class Relative Reads (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(p)
})

### 5. Name the list by drug class
names(plot_list) <- drug_classes

### 6. Example: show one plot
plot_list[["Rifamycin antibiotic"]]

### 7. Example: show another plot
plot_list[["Macrolide antibiotic"]]

  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file_name,
    plot = plot_list[[dc]],
    width = 6,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

### Study the Association between AMRs Abundances and Metadata Factors
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)

### Read in CARD-kmer results
card_result_file <- file.path("../../data/Metagenomics/CARD_amr", "mapping_summary.tsv")
card_result <- read.table(card_result_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
head(card_result)
# Extract Individual Name from Sample Name
card_result <- card_result %>%
  mutate(
    individual = str_extract(sample, "^[^_]+")
  )
head(card_result)


### Read in Individual Meta data
meta_data_file <- file.path("../../data/Metadata", "selected_northwood_map.txt")
#meta_data <- read.table(meta_data_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
meta_data <- read_tsv(meta_data_file)
head(meta_data)
# Extract Individual Name from Sample Name
meta_data <- meta_data %>%
  mutate(
    individual = str_extract(`#SampleID`, "^[^-]+")  # Extract the part before "-"，such as NW001
  )
head(meta_data)


### Study the association between AMR abundance and other factors
meta_card_result <- card_result %>% left_join(meta_data, by = "individual")
meta_card_result$mapped_reads_percentage <- meta_card_result$Mapped_reads/meta_card_result$Total_reads
head(meta_card_result)

# Sta the average and standard deviation of AMR Reads Percentages
summary(meta_card_result$mapped_reads_percentage)
meta_card_result %>% summarise(mapped_reads_percentage = sd(mapped_reads_percentage, na.rm = TRUE))

### Box Plot for the Percentage of AMR reads
AMR_boxplot <- ggplot(meta_card_result, aes(x = "", y = mapped_reads_percentage)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(
    title = "AMR Reads Percentage",
    x = "All Samples",
    y = "AMR Reads Percentage"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = meta_card_result %>% 
      filter(mapped_reads_percentage > 0.002),
    aes(label = individual),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 0.15,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5
  )
AMR_boxplot



### Scatter Plot for Total reads number and AMR mapped reads number
# 1) Fit a linear regression and extract slope/intercept/R2/p
fit <- lm(Mapped_reads ~ Total_reads, data = meta_card_result)
coefs <- coef(fit)
slope <- coefs[["Total_reads"]]
intercept <- coefs[["(Intercept)"]]
r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
pval <- summary(fit)$coefficients["Total_reads", "Pr(>|t|)"]

label_lm <- sprintf("y = %.3g x %+.3g\nR² = %.3f, p = %.2g",
                    slope, intercept, r2, pval)

# 2) Plot
AMR_scatter_plot <- ggplot(meta_card_result, aes(x = Total_reads, y = Mapped_reads)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +

### Numeric Variants
num_vars <- c("Age", "TimeNW", "FIScore")
corr_table <- purrr::map_dfr(num_vars, function(v) {
  df <- meta_card_indiv %>% select(average_mapped_reads_percentage, all_of(v)) %>% na.omit()
  if (nrow(df) < 3) return(NULL)

  ct <- cor.test(df$average_mapped_reads_percentage, df[[v]], method = "spearman")
  tibble(
    variable = v,
    n = nrow(df),
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = ct$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

corr_table
head(corr_table)


### Factor Variants
factor_vars <- c("Sex", "Location")

group_test <- purrr::map_dfr(factor_vars, function(v) {

  df <- meta_card_indiv %>%
    select(average_mapped_reads_percentage, all_of(v)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    mutate(group = as.factor(.data[[v]])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(average_mapped_reads_percentage))

  k <- n_distinct(df$group)
  if (k < 2) return(NULL)

  p <- if (k == 2) {
    wilcox.test(average_mapped_reads_percentage ~ group, data = df, exact = FALSE)$p.value
  } else {
    kruskal.test(average_mapped_reads_percentage ~ group, data = df)$p.value
  }

  tibble(
    variable  = v,
    n         = nrow(df),
    n_groups  = k,
    p_value   = p
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

group_test


### Scatter Plots for Numeric Factors
plot_scatter_pub <- function(df, xvar,
                             yvar = "average_mapped_reads_percentage",
                             label_var = "individual",
                             label_thr = 0.002,   # 0.2% = 0.002
                             point_size = 2.2) {

  # 1) Remove data with NA
  df_fit <- df %>%
    select(all_of(c(xvar, yvar, label_var))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(.data[[yvar]]))

  # # 2) Linear regression
  # m <- lm(reformulate(xvar, response = yvar), data = df_fit)
  # sm <- summary(m)
  # 
  # slope <- unname(coef(m)[2])
  # intercept <- unname(coef(m)[1])
  # r2 <- sm$r.squared
  # pval <- sm$coefficients[2, 4]
  # 
  # # 3) Slope annotation
  # info_txt <- paste0(
  #   "Slope = ", signif(slope, 3),
  #   "\nR² = ", signif(r2, 3),
  #   "\np = ", format.pval(pval, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3)
  # )

  cor_res <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(df_fit[[xvar]], df_fit[[yvar]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )

  rho <- unname(cor_res$estimate)
  pval <- cor_res$p.value

  info_txt <- paste0(
    #"n = ", nrow(df_fit),
    "\nSpearman \u03C1 = ", signif(rho, 3),
    "\nP = ", format.pval(pval, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3)
  )
  
  
  # 4) Points for AMR% > 0.2%
  df_lab <- df_fit %>% filter(.data[[yvar]] > label_thr)

  # 5) Plot
  x_rng <- range(df_fit[[xvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- range(df_fit[[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  x_anno <- 0.95 * x_rng[2]
  y_anno <- 0.95 * y_rng[2]
  
  ggplot(df_fit, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = point_size) +
    
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +

    geom_text_repel(
      data = df_lab,
      aes(label = .data[[label_var]]),
      size = 4,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      segment.alpha = 0.4
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +

    annotate("text",
      x = x_anno, y = y_anno,
      label = info_txt,
      hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
      size = 5
    ) +
    
    labs(
      # title = paste0("AMR reads percentage vs ", xvar),
      x = xvar,
      y = "AMR Relative Abundance"
    ) +

    # Set the theme
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
    )
}

### Boxplot for factors
plot_box <- function(df, fvar) {

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[fvar]]),
      !is.na(average_mapped_reads_percentage)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!fvar := as.factor(.data[[fvar]])
    )
  
  y_max <- max(df$average_mapped_reads_percentage, na.rm = TRUE)
  p_y <- 0.95 * y_max
  m_y <- 0.3 * y_max
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[fvar]], y = average_mapped_reads_percentage)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    labs(
      # title = paste("AMR Reads Percentage by", fvar),
      x = fvar,
      y = "AMR Relative Abundance"
    ) +
    theme(
      #plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
    ) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.x = 1.5,
      label.y = p_y
    ) +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median,
      geom = "text",
      aes(label = scales::percent(..y.., accuracy = 0.01)),
      vjust = -5,
      size = 5
    )
}
```

```{r}
### Plot Figures
plot_taxa_corr <- function(dat, taxa, out_dir = "../../results/MG_results/AMR_results/AMR_Taxa_association") {
  taxa_safe_name <- taxa %>%
  str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_") %>%
  str_sub(1, 120)
  
  df <- dat %>%
    filter(Taxa_Name == taxa) %>%
    filter(!is.na(RelAbund), !is.na(mapped_reads_percentage)) %>%
    distinct(Sample_key, Taxa_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

  if (nrow(df) < 3) return(NULL)

  # Spearman
  ct <- cor.test(df$RelAbund, df$mapped_reads_percentage, method = "spearman")

  # # Linear correlation
  # fit <- lm(mapped_reads_percentage ~ RelAbund, data = df)
  # slope <- coef(fit)[2]
  # p_lm  <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]
  
  # Add pseudocounts for log10 scale
  pseudo_x <- min(df$RelAbund[df$RelAbund > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2
  pseudo_y <- min(df$mapped_reads_percentage[df$mapped_reads_percentage > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2

  df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    RelAbund_plot = RelAbund + pseudo_x,
    AMR_plot = mapped_reads_percentage + pseudo_y
  )
  
  # ann <- paste0(
  #   "Spearman rho = ", round(unname(ct$estimate), 3),
  #   "\nSpearman p = ", format(ct$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
  #   "\nLM slope = ", signif(slope, 3),
  #   "\nLM p = ", format(p_lm, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
  #   "\nN = ", nrow(df)
  # )
  
  ann <- paste0(
  "Spearman \u03C1 = ", round(unname(ct$estimate), 3),
  "\nP = ", format.pval(ct$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 1e-3),
  "\nn = ", nrow(df)
)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = RelAbund, y = mapped_reads_percentage)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Taxa: ", taxa_safe_name),
      x = "Taxa Relative Abundance",
      y = "AMR Relative Abundance"
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = ann, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.1, size = 4) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 16, 8, 8)
    )

  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("TaxaCorr_", taxa_safe_name, ".jpg")),
    plot = p, width = 6, height = 6
  )

  p
}
```
